design.decision: Buy [2] cards and Opening effects that make [2]s (normally bad buys), and treat a hand full of [2]s as a reason to bid nil rather than a weak hand.
design.opponent: Only the sigil is visible; opponents cannot see how many [2]s the team holds and learn it as the [2]s are played.
design.rationale: Raises the kept cc-two-hold-mult (+10.9) from +mult to ×mult, and makes the downgrade enablers that measured very badly on their own (become [2]s) worth considering. The decision it changes is mainly in the shop and at Opening, which is a mild departure from 'changes a play decision'; a wild combo with uc-low-to-twos is acceptable because it needs luck.
design.draftText: ×1.25 contract multiplier for each [2] your team holds

critic.concerns: Same signature and amount as cut common e-hold-rank-2-xmult, and differs from ra-ace-hold-x only in named rank; it changes purchases and Opening, never a play.
